name: moonfin
//build: Append -- <version> to bump before building (npm run build:webos -- 2.2.0)

scripts.dev:webos: cd packages/app && cross-env REACT_APP_PLATFORM=webos npm run serve
scripts.dev:tizen: cd packages/app && cross-env REACT_APP_PLATFORM=tizen npm run serve
scripts.dev:vega: cd packages/app && cross-env REACT_APP_PLATFORM=vega npm run serve
scripts.dev:xbox: cd packages/app && cross-env REACT_APP_PLATFORM=xbox npm run serve

//cli-tools: @enact/cli and @webos-tools/cli are installed into the git-ignored tools/ folder by the postinstall above, not as devDependencies. See tools/package.json for why.
